dedupe_keys.name: ogc open modelling interface openmi standard

description: The Open Modelling Interface (OpenMI) is an OGC standard that lets process simulation models exchange data with each other at run time, and with databases and analysis or visualisation tools, so that independently developed components can be linked into integrated models. It covers the requirements a component must meet to be OpenMI compliant: a thin core set for establishing a link and exchanging data between two components, and optional extensions for more complex situations; it originates in earth surface and water modelling but applies to any domain where numerical models must exchange data while running. The standard is published by the Open Geospatial Consortium as OGC document 11-014r3, version 2.0, developed with the OpenMI Association, which provides implementation guidance and software tools for building compliant components. The standard document is available as a free PDF from OGC; the OGC page does not state a separate licence. Caveats: it defines interfaces, not an implementation, and the OpenMI Association's own website failed a certificate check when read today. It supports coupling of hydrological, drainage, energy or transport models for cascading failure, interdependency and climate adaptation studies across sectors; a related record is the eWaterCycle platform.
